title: Wheelhouse plugin registry (wheelhouse-registry.json)
description: A list of Wheelhouse plugins, each in a GitHub repository of its own, for the Plugins page to search and install. Fields not listed here are ignored, so a registry can add some without breaking older Wheelhouses.

schema.description: The registry format and its version. A Wheelhouse refuses a version it cannot read.

name.description: The plugin's id: its manifest's name. Wheelhouse hides it once a plugin with this id is installed.

displayName.description: What the Plugins page calls it.

icon.description: An .svg, .png, .webp or .ico image: an https address, or a path inside the registry repository, beside this file.

repository.description: The plugin's repository on GitHub, as org/repo: what Install fetches.

ref.description: A tag, branch or commit to install; the repository's default branch without one.
